name: Wolmido Sunset
desc: Wolmido island on Incheon's waterfront, built for the hour before sunset: the short walk from Incheon Station (line 1, Suin-Bundang line) to the Wolmi Sea Train monorail (the ticket is a round ticket: one ride out and one more the same day), all four monorail stops, the 5 km Wolmido walking loop (Naver Map's official line for Incheon Dulle-gil course 13), four cafés where reviewers watch the sunset, and public toilets. Hours and prices are as listed on Naver Map and Incheon city's pages in October 2026, so check before you go.

layers.name: Incheon Station to the monorail (인천역 → 월미바다역)

line.name: Incheon Station → Wolmi Sea Station, about 200 m

segments.label: Station forecourt, south on Jemullyang-ro, right onto Wolmi-ro (pedestrian router on OSM streets)

pins.name: Start – Incheon Station (인천역)
pins.desc: Jemullyang-ro 269. Line 1 terminus and the Suin-Bundang line. Walk south from the station forecourt and turn right on Wolmi-ro: Wolmi Sea Station, the first monorail stop, is about 200 m away (3 minutes).

layers.name: Wolmi Sea Train monorail stops (월미바다열차 정거장)

pins.name: 1. Wolmi Sea Station (월미바다역)
pins.desc: Wolmi-ro 6, beside Incheon Station: stop 1 and the ticket office. Anyone who booked online can only board here; tickets can be bought at all four stops. The monorail ticket is a round ticket: it covers one more ride on the same day, so you can get off at any stop, walk, and board again. Booking and timetable: wolmiseatrain.or.kr, tel. +82 32 450 7600. Walking path: 9 m.

pins.name: 2. Wolmi Park Station (월미공원역)
pins.desc: Wolmi-ro 482: stop 2, with a rooftop observatory (per Incheon city). The Wolmi Park main gate, where the walking path ends, is about 60 m away. Your round ticket works for one more ride from here. Walking path: 19 m.

pins.name: 3. Wolmi Culture Street Station (월미문화의거리역)
pins.desc: Wolmi-munhwa-ro 5: stop 3, north of Wolmi Culture Street. The station sits on the monorail's northern edge, about 350 m from the walking path, so walk south to the seafront street to rejoin it. Your round ticket works for one more ride from here.

pins.name: 4. Museum Station (박물관역)
pins.desc: Wolmi-ro 297: stop 4, at the Korea Emigration Museum. There is a public toilet at the stop. Your round ticket works for one more ride from here. Walking path: 64 m.

line.name: Wolmido walking path, 5.0 km: Incheon Station → Wolmi Culture Street → Wolmi Park (Incheon Dulle-gil course 13)

segments.label: Naver Map's official line for Incheon Dulle-gil course 13 (Wolmido), 192 points, used as published

pins.name: Wolmi Culture Street (월미문화의거리)
pins.desc: Wolmi-munhwa-ro 36-1. Wolmido's seafront street, with snack stalls, claw machines and the monorail passing overhead. The walking path runs right along it, 2.2 km from the start.

pins.name: Korea Emigration Museum (한국이민사박물관)
pins.desc: Wolmi-ro 329. Korea's first museum of emigration history, built by Incheon citizens and overseas Koreans for the 2003 centenary of emigration to the US (per Naver). It closed at 18:00 on 25 October, so check the day's hours and closed days. 86 m from the walking path, beside Museum Station.

pins.name: Wolmi Observatory (월미공원 월미전망대)
pins.desc: Hilltop observatory: three floors, 23 m high, with views of Incheon Port, the West Sea and Incheon Bridge, and a café inside (per Incheon city's Wolmi Park page). Reports say it takes about 30 minutes on foot to reach, or less by the park's shuttle. Naver showed it open until 21:30 on 25 October. 86 m from the walking path.

pins.name: Wolmi Traditional Garden (월미공원 전통정원)
pins.desc: Wolmi-ro 131-9. A Korean traditional garden at the foot of the observatory hill; visitor reviews mention reeds, animals and a quiet autumn stroll. 125 m from the walking path.

pins.name: End – Wolmi Park main gate (월미공원 정문)
pins.desc: The end of Incheon Dulle-gil course 13 (4.97 km, about 81 minutes on Naver Map). Wolmi Park Station is about 60 m away, so you can ride the monorail back to Wolmi Sea Station on the second half of your round ticket.

pins.name: Storage Incheon (스토리지 인천)
pins.desc: Wolmi-ro 33, 3rd and 4th floors, a few minutes' walk from Incheon Station and 30 m from the walking path. Big windows face the West Sea, and a reviewer's write-up is titled for its sunset view. Naver showed last order at 19:00 on 25 October.

pins.name: Wolmido Remi (월미도레미)
pins.desc: Wolmi-munhwa-ro 35, 2nd floor, in the middle of Wolmi Culture Street. Visitors praise the sea view, and the signature drink is the Wolmi Sunset Tea (월미선셋티), raspberry-grapefruit Earl Grey. Naver showed last order at 21:30 on 25 October. 135 m from the walking path.

pins.name: Me Too Coffee (미투커피)
pins.desc: Wolmi-munhwa-ro 39. A retro-styled café; the café's own description on Naver mentions 2nd-floor window seats over the sea and a rooftop terrace for dusk. Naver showed last order at 21:30 on 25 October. 77 m from the walking path.

pins.name: Artos Hope Party (아르토스 희망파티)
pins.desc: Wolmi-ro 226beon-gil 10, 5th floor of the Wolmi Ocean Terrace building. The café's own directions on Naver call the 5th floor 'beautiful for sunsets', and a blog titles it a Wolmido café with a lovely sunset. Naver showed closing at 20:00 on 25 October. 243 m from the walking path.

pins.name: Public toilet, Wolmi Park entrance (공중화장실 월미공원)
pins.desc: Wolmi-ro 131-50, by the Wolmi Park entrance and car park. 24 m from the walking path.

pins.name: Wolmi pier toilet (월미도뱃터화장실)
pins.desc: Wolmi-ro 237, at the Wolmi pier end of the culture street. 124 m from the walking path.

pins.name: Wolmi Culture Street toilet (월미도문화의거리화장실)
pins.desc: Wolmi-munhwa-ro 84, by the crane (학) stage at the west end of the culture street. 19 m from the walking path.

pins.name: Public toilet, Museum Station (공중화장실 박물관역)
pins.desc: Wolmi-ro 297, at the Museum Station monorail stop. 11 m from the walking path.
